scenes.text: Watch and read: Ama asks: Read: “First Ama found a lost pencil. Next Ama asked for help. Finally Ama returned the pencil to the teacher.” What happened finally?
The answer is: returned the pencil to the teacher. Look for the last event when retelling in order.
Watch and read: Ama asks: Which sentence supports this paragraph topic: “Our garden is beautiful.”?
The answer is: We grow green vegetables.. All sentences in a paragraph should develop one idea.
